title: Coverage Baseline
description: The recorded, enforced coverage floor for Mission Landing Zone. Stored at tests/coverage-baseline.json. The ratchet gate compares measured CI coverage against coveragePercent and fails when measured is below it.

coveragePercent.description: The enforced coverage floor as a percentage (0-100, 2 decimal places). Measured coverage MUST be >= this value to pass the ratchet gate. This value only ever increases except through an explicit, reviewed downward edit.

scope.description: Human-readable description of what was measured, e.g. 'src/artifacts/*.ps1'. Must match the measurement scope.

updated.description: ISO-8601 date the baseline was last ratcheted.

note.description: Optional short reason for the last change to the baseline.
